name: utf8_ansi_clear
script:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
e='\x1b'
for i in range(1, 8):
    sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[2J{e}[HFRAME-{i:02d} ✅ UTF8 中文 😀 {e}[31mRED{i:02d}{e}[0m\n")
sys.stdout.flush()
PY

name: osc8_truecolor_alt_screen
script:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
e='\x1b'
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[38;2;1;200;120mTRUECOLOR_OK{e}[0m\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}]8;;https://example.com{e}\\OSC8_LINK{e}]8;;{e}\\\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[?1049hALT_SCREEN_ON\n")
for i in range(1, 11):
    sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[2J{e}[Halt-frame-{i:02d}\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[?1049lALT_SCREEN_OFF\n")
sys.stdout.flush()
PY

name: csi_and_bracketed_paste
script:
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
e='\x1b'
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[sCURSOR_SAVE{e}[uCURSOR_RESTORE\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[2;5rSCROLL_REGION_SET\n{e}[rSCROLL_REGION_RESET\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[LINSERT_LINE{e}[MDELETE_LINE\n")
sys.stdout.write(f"{e}[?2004hBRACKET_MODE_ON\n{e}[200~PASTED_PAYLOAD{e}[201~\n{e}[?2004lBRACKET_MODE_OFF\n")
sys.stdout.write("CSI_PHASE2_DONE\n")
sys.stdout.flush()
PY
